name: Aaker’s Brand Personality Dimensions
diagnostic: How does the brand score across the five validated psychological dimensions, and which sub-facets serve as non-negotiable behavioral boundaries?
artifact: A 42-Facet Personality Trait Scorecard evaluating the brand on a 1–5 scale across five primary dimensions: Sincerity, Excitement, Competence, Sophistication, and Ruggedness.
trap: Scoring high across all five dimensions simultaneously, resulting in a diffuse identity profile that dilutes recognition.
pedigreeFull: Jennifer L. Aaker (Journal of Marketing Research, 1997). The foundational empirical psychometric model validating how human personality traits project onto commercial brands.
